turns: 11; I added `e2e/api/generated/AUTH-06.spec.ts` with one test tagged `@AUTH-06`. It passes with `npx playwright test --project=api api/generated/AUTH-06.spec.ts`, and `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. No other file was changed.

The test signs in the seeded member through `apiAs("member")`, calls `POST /api/auth/logout` (the endpoint found in `backend/src/vendor_intake/routes/auth.py`), and asserts:
- the response is 204, checked with `expectStatus`;
- a `session` Set-Cookie header is present with an empty value and `Max-Age=0`.

The cookie-value check accepts both `session=` and `session=""`. My first version expected the unquoted form and failed; the server sends the quoted form, which the backend's own sign-out test also accepts, so I relaxed that one check. The test creates no data, so parallel runs don't conflict.
